findings.source_en: A discarded memento, forsaken by a disciple who found himself drawn to a new sense of purpose.
findings.ar: تذكارٌ مهجور، تخلّى عنه تلميذٌ وجد نفسه منجذبًا إلى غايةٍ جديدة.
findings.issue: Disciple is now frozen as الحواريّ (~35 rows corpus-wide, and deliberately distinct from التابِع/المُريد/عابد الطائفة). This row still renders it تلميذ, so the cult role is named by a generic word for 'student' here and by the frozen term everywhere else.
findings.suggested_ar: تذكارٌ مهجور، تخلّى عنه حواريٌّ وجد نفسه منجذبًا إلى غايةٍ جديدة.

findings.issue: In this node the lute-player is Tiel and the listener is Genessa: her line 'Play me a song' is masculine (اعزف لي لحنًا), so the person being asked to play is male, and 'with a face like this' is Tiel's rash (cf. the TheRash memory). That makes Tiel the speaker of the confession lines, and his addressee - Genessa - must be feminine. عِدني ألّا تضحك is masculine throughout, so as written Tiel is asking another man not to laugh.

findings.source_en: Bring to Zhirelle, the Shell Keeper to sever your bond with a shell
findings.ar: أحضرها إلى زيريل، حارسة الهَياكل، لقطع رابطتك بأحد الهَياكل.
findings.issue: Shellkeeper is frozen as حارس الهَياكل and appears in that exact form as Zhirelle's nameplate (ST_Core_Menu_Shellkeeper/ShellkeeperName). Here the same title is feminized to حارسة الهَياكل. Zhirelle is female so the agreement is defensible, but the title cannot be spelled two ways; the owner needs to rule whether the frozen title inflects for her.
findings.suggested_ar: أحضرها إلى زيريل، حارس الهَياكل، لقطع رابطتك بأحد الهَياكل.

findings.issue: 'Hooman' is a deliberate dog-speak misspelling of 'human' - it is the entire joke of this fake achievement, and its sibling description ('He didn't hurt anybody...') is written from the dog's side. إنسان سيء is clean prose and reads as a flat scolding, losing the animal voice.
